comment: Plugins in their own repositories that this release offers (INSTALL_PLUGIN, HelixScreen Settings > Plugins) and is tested with (tools/test_plugin_repos.sh). components: Moonraker components that must load (test only).

plugins.name: notify
plugins.title: Notifications
plugins.description: Print notifications with a camera photo: Telegram, Discord, ntfy, e-mail and 100+ more (set up with NOTIFY_SETUP)

plugins.name: timelapse
plugins.title: Timelapse
plugins.description: Timelapse videos of your prints from the camera (Fluidd's Timelapse tab)

plugins.name: spoolman
plugins.title: Spoolman
plugins.description: A Spoolman spool per IFS slot: the loaded slot's spool is the active one (needs a Spoolman server)

plugins.name: happy-hare
plugins.title: Happy Hare
plugins.description: Happy Hare MMU software in place of Kiln's IFS driver: tool changes parked at the toolhead, the IFS synced with the extruder, clog detection from the IFS stall sensors (needs the IFS on Klipper firmware)
